title: Covenia Spectracraft
description: an early alphastage modpack that attempts to grab as much cool stuff and building mods as possible while still being playable on potato PCs.
body:
**_Early alpha!!!_**

**No garuntees on working state or maintenance. Uploaded to modrinth so it can be downloaded to Questcraft.**
INFO: Tested, does not work on Questcraft. Was worth a shot, no idea what's breaking it.

Combines Spectrum and Immersive Portals with as many building mods and other small cool things that will fit, without the overbearing large modpack feel. No JEI or similar to avoid it being a Find Item In Menu sim, no mods that won't be playable without JEI.

Designed for VR, but has a couple accessory mods to attempt to bring VR QOL to flatscreen.
